adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, when `refresh_token` is missing it is forcibly set to the literal string `"refresh_token"` (`refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"`). In the O365 refresh flow (`packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`), the returned `tokenResponse.data` is spread over existing `o365AuthCredentials` (`{ ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`), so this dummy value will overwrite a previously valid `o365AuthCredentials.refresh_token` and then be persisted via `prisma.credential.update`, causing real refresh tokens to be replaced with junk.
